This charming 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom homestead offers 1,594 square feet of living space on 2.16 acres, with the unique opportunity to own an additional 2.54-acre parcel.

Inside, the kitchen blends functionality and warmth, featuring ample cabinetry, a breakfast nook, counter-height bar, quartz countertops, and a solid copper sink. Throughout the home, large windows fill the living space with natural light & beautiful seasonal views. The cozy living room features a pellet stove, creating a warm and inviting space to relax & enjoy the changing seasons.

The primary suite has been thoughtfully designed with a large sliding glass door overlooking the scenic yard. Attached is the ensuite bathroom with a sleek glass panel shower, soaking tub, vanity, and walk-in closet. The two additional bedrooms offer ample space for family or guests. 
A dedicated family bathroom and Indoor laundry room line the hall. 

Outside, the property is enhanced by raised garden beds filled with seasonal florals, Decorative landscaping, and mature trees.

Primary Parcel: The main property includes the residence, security fencing, designated livestock areas, a fenced paddock, and a corral with a stall suitable for horses, donkeys, goats, or sheep. Smaller, secure enclosures provide additional space for chickens, ducks, pigs, and other animals. Additional features include water access, a spacious henhouse with automatic solar-timed doors, leased solar panels, a gated entry, and a solar-powered security system.
Adding to the property's unique character is a rare piece of American history—an original WWII-era bunker preserved in beautiful condition.

Additional Parcel: The separate 2.54-acre parcel includes its own private water meter.

The backyard provides a welcoming setting for outdoor living, with a large shade tree, desert-inspired planters, and a spacious fire pit beneath string lights. Enjoy sweeping views and beautiful sunsets while entertaining guests or unwinding after a long day.
Potential opportunities for short-term rental or guest accommodations may also exist, subject to applicable regulations.

Conveniently located near the Antelope Valley California Poppy Reserve, Lake Hughes, Lake Elizabeth, and Quail Lake, this property offers a peaceful rural setting with room to live, grow, and explore. Close to the 14 freeway, 5 freeway, and a short drive to Hard Rock Casino Tejon

Five bedrooms, paid off solar, a remodeled primary bath, a spa, RV parking, and a cul de sac location.

(5th Bed option).Over 3,000 square feet of incredibly versatile living space in one of West Lancaster’s most desirable neighborhoods, this 4-bedroom, 3-bathroom residence is perfectly designed to adapt to an evolving lifestyle. Step through the front doors into a peaceful formal living area lined with high end TRAVERTINE tiles and a large, flexible adjoining space. Currently used as a formal dining room, this area easily transitions into a spacious home office, library, or creative studio. Downstairs, you will also find a highly coveted first-floor guest bedroom and full bathroom, making it ideal for hosting out-of-town guests, a growing family, or accommodating multi-generational living. Everyday living effortlessly revolves around the expansive, open-concept great room. The kitchen is built for both busy weekday mornings and weekend entertaining, featuring a massive granite center island with built-in seating, abundant cabinetry, and a walk-in pantry. Two additional generously sized bedrooms share a full, central bathroom to round out the upper floor. Outside, east-facing sliding doors off the great room open to a private, secure backyard enclosed by a sturdy block privacy wall. The outdoor space features a poured concrete slab with footings which was an over $8,000 investment, acting as a blank canvas ready for a custom awning or patio setup. Comfort and efficiency are built right into this property. The home’s facade is shaded by beautiful, mature trees that naturally cool the home during the summer months, perfectly complementing the DUAL-climate zoned HVAC system. Finally, a two-car attached garage provides direct, convenient access straight through the dedicated laundry room and into the kitchen. Nestled in a premier, quiet neighborhood, this home offers unparalleled convenience for families, located just minutes from Lancaster Elementary, Endeavour Middle School, and Lancaster High. Space, flexibility, and a prime location!!

results.remarks:
***LIVE BEAUTIFULLY***
Welcome to this charming Lancaster home filled with character, warmth, and timeless appeal. This spacious 5-bedroom, 4-bathroom property offers an inviting layout with beautiful exposed wood-beam ceilings, rich wood paneling, and hardwood flooring throughout the main living spaces. As you enter, the living room immediately draws you in with a stunning stone hearth as its centerpiece, creating a warm and welcoming gathering space. Just beyond, the reverse side features beautiful brickwork that carries into the adjacent family room, complete with a charming bar area and abundant wood detailing.

The home also features a formal dining room, spacious kitchen with ample cabinetry and a convenient breakfast bar, plus a laundry room with plenty of storage. The primary suite offers its own fireplace, an oversized walk-in closet, and an ensuite bath with dual sinks, large soaking tub, and walk-in shower. A secondary bedroom also features a fireplace, while another bedroom includes an attached full bathroom with access leading toward a spacious bonus room and office area.

Step outside to a large backyard designed for entertaining and relaxing, featuring grassy space, a generous concrete patio, sparkling pool, and outdoor fireplace. A detached guest bedroom with its own full bathroom provides additional flexibility for guests, extended family, or a private retreat. From the wood-beamed ceilings and multiple gathering spaces to the poolside setting and detached guest accommodations, this home offers plenty of character and space for both everyday living and entertaining.

The dining area opens through expansive sliding glass doors to the backyard, while the open kitchen overlooks the great room, dining area, and outdoor living spaces beyond. The laundry room offers abundant cabinetry, a utility sink, and side-by-side washer and dryer, plus direct access to the attached two-car garage featuring a versatile bonus area - ideal for an office, hobbies, or additional storage. Out back, a covered patio extends the main living spaces outdoors, offering easy indoor-outdoor access for everyday living and entertaining. Framed by block walls for privacy, the backyard offers comfortable space to lounge, dine, or entertain outdoors. From its flexible floor plan and inviting indoor-outdoor living to its prime West Lancaster location, this home offers space, comfort, and convenience inside and out. Come experience this beautiful home for yourself this weekend!

From the moment you step inside, you'll appreciate the generous scale of the home. The single-story floor plan offers an easy flow from room to room, with spacious living areas and bedrooms that provide plenty of flexibility for family, guests, a home office, or whatever your lifestyle calls for. Move-in ready, single story, owned solar, new HVAC, and a pool that sells itself!
